_comment: Arbitrum One. Core addresses were read from the deployed contracts, not from docs; see README. Market params must match Morpho Blue exactly, since the market Id is keccak256(abi.encode(params)) and a typo silently produces a valid-looking Id for a market that does not exist. Deploy.s.sol checks each one against Morpho before registering.
_marketsComment: marketCount must match the array length: Foundry has no way to read an array's length from JSON, and struct-decoding an array depends on alphabetical field ordering, which is far more fragile than one explicit number. loanToken must equal asset above or registerMarket reverts LoanTokenMismatch. maxLeverage is a ceiling on what an action may request, not a target. The three risk-limit fields here are per-market; global ones live under .riskLimits.
_seedComment: Minted to the burn address, never to the deployer. Seeding closes the first-depositor inflation window because the donation needed to floor a victim scales with 1000 * victimDeposit * (seed + 1); shares that could be redeemed later would reopen it. See test/unit/InflationAttack.t.sol.
_vaultComment: actionDropToleranceBps caps how much value one executeActions batch may destroy. Contract default is 100 (1%); the vault hard-caps it at 1000.
_riskLimitsComment: Global thresholds only; per-market ones live on each market entry. Every threshold is fail-open: 0 means unenforced. rateLimitWindowSeconds MUST be set before any maxExposureChangePerWindow or the setter reverts RateLimitWindowNotSet, since a zero window silently turns a per-window budget into a per-action one. maxSlippageBpsCeiling bounds slippage a trade actually realized, measured after the fact, so it can sit below a market's own maxSlippageBps.
